note: Repeated brightfield screening on this holder. The licence covers parameter sweeps inside these ranges and nothing else: an optical path change, a manual device or an irreversible action still needs an individual approval (6.1). It dies on its own at the end of the window, at twenty runs, if the lamp calibration is redone, or the first time a run breaches its stop criteria.
